feat(l1): define L1 Boot, Firmware & Hardware Abstraction contracts (Issue #136)

Catalog integration of the owner Sollarchitektur from Issue #136
(architecture_id ATC-LAYER-L1-BOOT-FIRMWARE-HAL):

- Registry v0.3.0: L1 expanded to the 9 owner-specified sub-layers
  (L1.1 Boot Manager ... L1.9 Kernel Handoff & Platform Contract)
  with system boundaries, SSOT assignment, and the untrusted-
  firmware-input principle documented
- New ATC-L1-FUNCTION-CATALOG-001.yaml: all 56 function contracts
  (ATC-L1-BOOT/SEC/FW/PLAT/HAL/DEV/LOAD/DIAG/HO-001..007) with
  full metadata schema, system boundaries, SSOT assignment table,
  8 layer dependency contracts, 10 acceptance criteria from the
  issue (incl. negative tests and the VERIFIED-requires-exact-
  commit rule)
- Implementation inventory at globus-os main 3bf0001:
  - 14 contracts IMPLEMENTED with inline test references and
    workspace suite evidence (1298/1298, exit 0 at exact SHA):
    BOOT-003, SEC-001, SEC-004, PLAT-001, PLAT-006, HAL-002,
    HAL-003, DEV-001, DEV-002, HO-001, HO-002, DIAG-002/003/004
  - 16 contracts MAPPED (source exists with SSOT binding, test
    evidence unconfirmed): BOOT-004, SEC-002/003/006, PLAT-002/
    003/004, HAL-004/005, DEV-003, LOAD-004, HO-003/004/006,
    DIAG-001, FW-003
  - 26 contracts UNRESOLVED with evidence-based reasons (no UEFI
    service consumption, no measured boot, no DMA/IOMMU capture,
    no kernel-image verification, no NUMA exposure, etc.)
- Validator generalized: validate_function_catalog() now validates
  any layer function catalog against the registry; L0 and L1 both
  validated (25/25 checks total, 0 errors)
- Architecture doc v0.3.0: L1 detail section added

Honesty rules preserved: no contract VERIFIED (CI evidence at
binding SHA pending); green CI alone insufficient per Issue #136.
